premises.text: Air pollution accounts for significant economic losses and health issues globally
premises.evidence_span: Air pollution accounts for $5 trillion of losses in economic output each year. One in eight deaths globally can be attributed to the long-term effects of pollution.

premises.text: There is a gap between the urgency to tackle pollution and the science-based insights needed for investment
premises.evidence_span: there's a gap between this urgency to tackle this pollution problem and the science-based insights that actually enable us to target investment into doing so.

premises.text: Havadava can convert satellite air quality data into ground-level values to improve accuracy
premises.evidence_span: downscaling satellite resolution into street-level granularity is actually helping us improve the accuracy of our air quality models by up to 80% for certain types of pollutants.

premises.text: Cities can build new urban mobility systems based on pollution data insights
premises.evidence_span: we're actually enabling cities to build entirely new urban mobility systems based on our understanding of pollution data.

premises.text: A subscription model for air quality data can generate revenue
premises.evidence_span: We're offering a data subscription at the moment and we've established a partnership model which basically enables us to leverage the atmosphere.

premises.text: Partnerships with global companies can enhance data coverage and validation
premises.evidence_span: we're counting Munich Ray, Swisscom, IBM, Siemens as customers along with 20 other cities across Germany, Switzerland and the UK who are already paying for our data.

value.text: Air quality data is essential for improving public health and urban planning
